name: android-use
description: Control an enrolled Android phone with fresh visual feedback, guarded operations and optional local diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Operate your Android phone with visual feedback
interface.longDescription: Use an explicitly enrolled Android phone over authorized USB or Wi-Fi debugging. Operate apps and browsers, inspect fresh screenshots, enter Unicode text and run guarded sequences. Phone enrollment and permissions remain operator-controlled. Diagnostic logging is off by default.
defaultPrompt: Use my enrolled Android phone to complete a task and verify the result.
